title: Grateful Dead Live at O'Keefe Center on 1967-08-05

ai_review.summary: High‑energy early Dead with a smoking Lovelight and Alligator captured on solid soundboard tape.
ai_review.review: This two‑song recording showcases the band at a peak of primal excitement, featuring a blistering first turn of "Turn On Your Lovelight" and an acid‑rock masterpiece in "Alligator." Reviewers rave about the raw energy, Pigpen’s vocal fire, and tight ensemble work, while noting that the soundboard source is clear enough for modern listening with only minor EQ tweaks needed.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer scores (average ~4.8) and enthusiastic comments about both performance and acceptable sound quality lead to a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is acceptably workable; reviewers mention it’s clear enough but suggest EQ adjustments for optimal playback. No major dropouts or distortion reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only two tracks, but the set flows powerfully with high‑octane delivery; both songs are highlighted as early standouts.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for tearing up the place and inspiring Pigpen’s vocal fire; reviewers note his deep, soulful playing.
band_member_comments.Bob: His guitar tone is described as rich and full, standing out even without a drum solo.
